```{r , eval=FALSE}
k13_varaint <- read.csv("/mnt/storage13/ahri/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/all_country_merged/WGS_Pf_Ethiopia_2024/genotype_extraction/k13_target/target_positions_genotypes_k13.csv",header=TRUE)

colnames(popgen_metadata) <- c("sample")

k13_variant_ethiopia <- k13_varaint %>%
    filter(sample %in% popgen_metadata$sample)%>%
    mutate(status = case_when(
        grepl("1",genotype) ~ "mutant",
        TRUE ~ "wildtype"
    ))%>%
    select(sample, status)%>%
    dplyr::rename(Sample = sample)
# filtering to sample that I know populations for 
fix_with_AD_gat_filt_samples_ethiopia_known = fix_with_AD_gat_filt %>% 
  filter(sample %in% k13_variant_ethiopia$Sample) %>% 
  group_by(CHROM, POS, sample) %>%
  mutate(total_AD = sum(AD)) %>% 
  mutate(wsaf = AD/total_AD) %>% 
  left_join(k13_variant_ethiopia %>% 
              select(Sample, status) %>% 
              dplyr::rename(sample = Sample))

# since taking a subset of samples, filter to positions where there are more than one variant 
fix_with_AD_gat_filt_samples_ethiopia_known_with_variation = fix_with_AD_gat_filt_samples_ethiopia_known %>% 
  group_by(CHROM, POS) %>% 
  filter(n_distinct(base) > 1)

# get within sample frequency weighted allele freqs, by taking a within sample frequency can mitigate somewhat the fact we don't know COI 
fix_with_AD_gat_filt_samples_ethiopia_known_with_variation_allele_freqs = fix_with_AD_gat_filt_samples_ethiopia_known_with_variation %>% 
  group_by(CHROM, POS, status) %>% 
  mutate(total_wsaf = sum(wsaf)) %>% 
  group_by(CHROM, POS, base, total_wsaf, status) %>% 
  summarise(wsaf_sum = sum(wsaf)) %>% 
  mutate(allele_freq = wsaf_sum/total_wsaf) %>% 
  dplyr::rename(total_population_sample_count = total_wsaf, 
                population = status) %>% 
  unite(CHROM_POS, CHROM, POS, sep = "-", remove = F) %>% 
  arrange(CHROM, POS, base, population)
```

```{r,eval=FALSE}
quick_summary <- function(x, probs = c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) {
  q <- quantile(x, probs = probs, na.rm = TRUE)
  tibble(
    n = length(x[!is.na(x)]), 
    sd = sd(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    min  = min(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    max  = max(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    !!!setNames(as.list(q), paste0("q", probs*100))
  )
}

# heterozygosity function 
He <- function(p) {
  1 - sum(p^2)
}


#' Calculates Jost's D and GST between two allele frequency vectors, vectors must be named and missing alleles from either population will be assumed to be zero 
#'
#' @param freqA named allele frequency vector of population A
#' @param freqB named allele frequency vector of population B
#'
#' @returns a tibble with Hs, Ht, Gst, JostD
#' @export
#'
pairwise_stats <- function(freqA, freqB) {
  # freqA / freqB are named numeric vectors: names = alleles
  alleles <- union(names(freqA), names(freqB))
  pA <- freqA[alleles]; pA[is.na(pA)] <- 0
  pB <- freqB[alleles]; pB[is.na(pB)] <- 0
  
  HeA <- He(pA)
  HeB <- He(pB)
  Hs  <- mean(c(HeA, HeB))
  
  pbar <- (pA + pB) / 2
  Ht   <- He(pbar)
  
  Gst  <- ifelse(Ht == 0, NA_real_, (Ht - Hs) / Ht)
  JostD <- ifelse((1 - Hs) == 0, NA_real_,
                  2 * (Ht - Hs) / (1 - Hs))
  
  tibble(Hs = Hs, Ht = Ht, Gst = Gst, JostD = JostD)
}

# collapse freq calls into named vectors so the above helper functions can work 
pairwise_pop_diff = fix_with_AD_gat_filt_samples_ethiopia_known_with_variation_allele_freqs %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(CHROM_POS, population, base, allele_freq) %>%
  group_by(CHROM_POS, population) %>%
  summarize(freqs = list(setNames(allele_freq, base)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(CHROM_POS) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(population) >= 2) %>% # i add this filtering to remove out loci which have found only in one pop
  summarize(
    freqs_by_pop = list(setNames(freqs, population)),
    pop_pairs    = list(combn(population, 2, simplify = FALSE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    stats = map2(pop_pairs, freqs_by_pop, \(pp, fbyp) {
      map_dfr(pp, \(pair) {
        pairwise_stats(fbyp[[pair[1]]], fbyp[[pair[2]]]) %>%
          mutate(pop1 = pair[1], pop2 = pair[2])
      })
    })
  ) %>%
  select(CHROM_POS, stats) %>%
  unnest(stats) %>% # add in population size counts so can filter off low coverage in populations to exclude high pop diff measures based on just low sample counts 
  left_join(
    fix_with_AD_gat_filt_samples_ethiopia_known_with_variation_allele_freqs %>% 
      ungroup() %>% 
      select(CHROM_POS, population, total_population_sample_count) %>% 
      unique()  %>% 
      dplyr::rename(pop1 = population, 
                    pop1_sample_count = total_population_sample_count)
  )%>% 
  left_join(
    fix_with_AD_gat_filt_samples_ethiopia_known_with_variation_allele_freqs %>% 
      ungroup() %>% 
      select(CHROM_POS, population, total_population_sample_count) %>% 
      unique() %>% 
      dplyr::rename(pop2 = population, 
                    pop2_sample_count = total_population_sample_count)
  )

# filter to populations with at least 10 samples each 
pairwise_pop_diff_filt = pairwise_pop_diff %>% 
  filter(pop1_sample_count > 10, 
         pop2_sample_count > 10) %>% 
  separate(CHROM_POS, remove = F, sep = "-", into = c("CHROM", "POS"), convert = T)

write_tsv(pairwise_pop_diff_filt, "/mnt/storage13/ahri/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/all_country_merged/WGS_Pf_Ethiopia_2024/jostD_stat/multialleic/k13_622I/ethopia_by_k13_622I_JostD_multiallelic.tsv")

# getting a summary of JostD for all pairwise comparisons between samples
pairwise_pop_diff_filt_mean_JostD = pairwise_pop_diff_filt %>% 
  rowwise() %>% 
  mutate(pair_id = paste0(sort(c(pop1, pop2)), collapse = " vs ")) %>% 
  group_by(pair_id) %>% 
  summarise(quick_summary(JostD)) %>% 
  arrange(desc(mean))


write_tsv(pairwise_pop_diff_filt_mean_JostD, "/mnt/storage13/ahri/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/all_country_merged/WGS_Pf_Ethiopia_2024/jostD_stat/multialleic/k13_622I/ethopia_by_k13_622I_JostD_multiallelic_summary.tsv")
```

```{r,eval=FALSE}
gene_regions <- labels_data
# Extract chromosome number
gene_regions$chr_num <- as.numeric(gsub("Pf3D7_", "", gsub("_v3", "", gene_regions$chr)))

# Initialize x position columns
gene_regions$x_start <- NA_real_
gene_regions$x_end <- NA_real_

jost_plot$POS <- as.numeric(jost_plot$POS)

gene_regions$start <- as.numeric(gene_regions$start)
gene_regions$end <- as.numeric(gene_regions$end)
gene_regions$chr_num <- as.numeric(gene_regions$chr_num)
# Loop through each gene
for(i in 1:nrow(gene_regions)) {
  current_chr <- gene_regions$chr_num[i]
  current_start <- gene_regions$start[i]
  current_end <- gene_regions$end[i]
  
  cat(sprintf("\nProcessing %s (chr %d, %d-%d)...\n", 
              gene_regions$gene_name[i], current_chr, current_start, current_end))
  
  # Filter SNPs for this chromosome
  chr_snps <- jost_plot %>% filter(chr_num == current_chr)
  
  cat(sprintf("  Found %d SNPs on chromosome %d\n", nrow(chr_snps), current_chr))
  
  if(nrow(chr_snps) > 0) {
    # Find closest start position
    start_snp <- chr_snps %>%
      mutate(dist = abs(POS - current_start)) %>%
      slice_min(dist, n = 1)
    
    gene_regions$x_start[i] <- start_snp$x_pos[1]
    
    # Find closest end position
    end_snp <- chr_snps %>%
      mutate(dist = abs(POS - current_end)) %>%
      slice_min(dist, n = 1)
    
    gene_regions$x_end[i] <- end_snp$x_pos[1]
    
    cat(sprintf("  x_pos: %.2f to %.2f\n", gene_regions$x_start[i], gene_regions$x_end[i]))
  } else {
    cat("  WARNING: No SNPs found on this chromosome!\n")
  }
}

gene_regions_with_pos <- gene_regions
```
